policy: Authentic artifact evidence must come from the listed official mission or media page. Select an individual asset only after item-level credit and third-party rights review. Generated images may not replace authentic evidence.

candidates.preferred_asset: photograph or spacecraft illustration explicitly credited by NASA/JPL
Apollo 11 surface photograph showing the reflector or experiment deployment
Viking 1 lander image or surface panorama with item credit
Spirit rover self-image, landing-site image, or official spacecraft illustration
Perseverance image of Ingenuity or official NASA/JPL illustration
official spacecraft illustration and authentic Eros image
official Voyager spacecraft image or illustration and authentic planetary/interstellar data visual
official spacecraft illustration plus authentic Pluto or Arrokoth image
